test: the shot columns join all 1,900 matches with no missing cell
detail: the same join Phase 5B gated at 1,900/1,900. Re-asserted here because this instrument reads different COLUMNS of the same file and a column can be absent where a row is not

test: the source's known defects are exactly the ones the audit recorded, in count
detail: NOT REPAIRED. One impossible row (Newcastle 2-4 West Ham, AS 8 / AST 9) and twelve rows where goals exceed SoT, which are the expected signature of own goals rather than corruption. The counts are asserted so a source that changes underneath this rung fails here rather than being absorbed into a rating

test: no odds column survives into the frame the ratings are fitted from
detail: the file is now read for two purposes and that does not merge the purposes. Only the twelve shot columns are selected out of it, by name, and this asserts the selection rather than trusting it. Survivors: none

test: the residual block is missing exactly where a team has fewer than five prior matches in the season, and nowhere else
detail: the window never crosses a season boundary (E6.3), so every season restarts with five matchweeks of unavailable rows. NaN is imputed to the TRAINING median by the pipeline's declared rule and carries an availability indicator, exactly as the project's other optional columns do

test: the D1 backbone the base rung is built from contains none of the six new columns
detail: block_of() classifies an unrecognised name as phase1_backbone and d1_features() selects the backbone by exclusion, so attaching before reading the base puts the new block INSIDE the control arm. This check exists because that is exactly what happened on the first run. 84 is a count of FEATURE NAMES; they expand to 88 design columns through the categoricals, which is what DS3a asserts separately

test: E1b's design is exactly D2 rescaled plus the six declared columns
detail: checked by NAME on the built design, not by counting. A count of six is not the same claim as the six being the declared six

test: Amendment 4's robust mask still selects exactly its three columns at D2_rescaled
detail: E6.6: the residuals are NOT DC-derived and must not take robust scaling. This is the check that would catch them drifting into it: rel_attack_diff, rel_defence_diff, expected_total_goals

test: Amendment 4's robust mask still selects exactly its three columns at E1b
detail: E6.6: the residuals are NOT DC-derived and must not take robust scaling. This is the check that would catch them drifting into it: rel_attack_diff, rel_defence_diff, expected_total_goals

test: the three availability indicators pass through unstandardised, and the three residuals do not
detail: section 6 classifies by column KIND, so the indicators were built as bool dtype rather than as 0/1 floats. This asserts the classifier agreed

test: no applicable rung/fold selects a lambda on a grid boundary
detail: EPV 0.90 to 3.80, far below the applicability threshold of 10, so the gate is live at every rung and fold. Boundary selections: none

test: the D2 rescaled base re-fitted here reproduces the committed Amendment 4 artefact bit for bit
detail: re-fitted rather than read so the E1b - D2rescaled delta is a genuinely PAIRED bootstrap from one process

test: every artefact read for comparison aligns row-for-row with this rung's pooled ordering
detail: all sorted by (season, date, home, away) and their result columns compared elementwise against this instrument's own ordering

test: with an all-False mask the local pipeline reproduces I4.fit_pipeline bit-for-bit
detail: the pass-through rule of section 6 is the ONLY difference between them; anchoring it here is what makes the new code path readable as Phase 3's, plus one declared change

test: design columns passing through unstandardised
detail: section 6: boolean and indicator columns are neither centred nor scaled. Classified by column KIND, never by observed values

test: DC state is invariant to corrupting every match from the cutoff onward, at 6 probe dates
detail: the window is matches with date STRICTLY < cutoff, so nothing at or after the cutoff can reach the fit. Tested by corruption rather than by re-reading the filter

test: every Elo before-rating follows from earlier matches alone, under Phase 2's declared season-transition policy
detail: 3800 before-ratings checked against continuing / promoted / returning-after-absence, the three cases of Phase 1's transition table. A before-rating that is a pure function of the team's own earlier matches cannot carry information from later ones

test: each match's DC fitting window is exactly the count of matches strictly earlier in date
detail: an off-by-one here would put same-day matches into their own fitting window, which is the classic form of this leak

test: no outer-test row appears in any outer or inner training set
detail: checked across every rung, every outer fold and every inner fold

test: the fitted scaler reproduces exactly from the training rows alone
detail: recomputed independently of the pipeline, from the training rows only; a test row leaking into the scaler would move this

test: no column takes the zero-scale guard while actually varying
detail: the guard means 'this column is constant, so do not scale it'. Where the column is NOT constant the guard leaves it in raw units inside a penalised fit. Offenders: none

test: design widths match Amendment 3's table A3.2
detail: D3 and D4 are NOT fitted in this session; their widths are computed from the frozen feature file, which is what DS3's nesting claim needs and is not a fit

test: strict nesting D1 < D2 < D3 < D4
detail: the ladder is nested by construction - each rung is the previous column set plus its own

test: D2's columns are D1's columns plus exactly the four dynamic-state columns
detail: checked on the built matrices, not on the feature lists

test: corrupting 2025-2026's features moves no selected lambda
detail: E1b, all four folds re-selected on the corrupted matrix

test: corrupting 2025-2026's features moves no OTHER fold's predictions
detail: 2025-2026 is the only season that is a test season and never a training season, so this assertion is not true by construction

test: CONTROL: its own fold's predictions DO move
detail: without this the two checks above would pass on a corruption that never landed

test: corrupting 2025-2026's labels moves no selected lambda
detail: labels of an outer-test season enter scoring and nothing else; if they reached the inner CV this would move

test: D0 reproduces Phase 2's frozen base rate on all six metrics and all three class rates
detail: all four folds; D0 is Phase 2's baseline re-derived, so any divergence would mean the fold structure had moved under it

test: a second full run of every fitted rung reproduces every probability bit-for-bit
detail: Newton from a zero start on a strictly convex objective, and a seeded bootstrap; nothing here should have a source of variation

test: and selects the same lambda at every fold
detail: the selection is a deterministic minimum with a declared tie-break

test: every rung's pooled and per-fold output passes the harness's validate_probabilities
detail: 2 probability arrays checked. The harness raises rather than repairing, so a renormalised break cannot pass silently

test: frozen_manifest.py --verify: no frozen artefact moved hash
detail: not cover. Re-run without --verify to adopt them.

test: extracted DC state through Phase 2's own outcome_probabilities() reproduces dc_walkforward
detail: 1520 test rows; extracted 0.9903635065 against Phase 2's four-fold mean 0.9903635065. The state D2 is built from is the state DC scored

test: every inner split has max(train date) STRICTLY < min(validation date)
detail: 32 inner splits across every fitted rung and fold; the tightest gap is 1 day(s). This is the constraint that forced the calendar date to replace the (season, matchweek) block

test: adding the residual block disturbed no column of the frozen Phase 3 feature file
detail: the six new columns are BUILT here, not read from the frozen file, so DS7a's byte-identity claim does not apply to them. What does apply is that they must not have changed anything they sit beside, checked against a fresh re-read from disk. Disturbed: none
